Art

Border

Knocks the edge of the design out to the shirt, great for square photos. Fades shrink the dots, so the print stays DTF-safe.

Look

Screen

Full colour in 4 screens. On a dark shirt: white base + cyan, magenta, yellow (the shirt is the black). On a light shirt: C, M, Y, K.

Unticked = knockout: every spot gets exactly one tone, which saves ink.

On a dark shirt with a white base, the base is one of these screens.

Text

Curve bends a line into an arch (right) or a smile (left).

Tone

Texture

Any grunge, paper or distress image. Dark parts wear the print away. It appears in the list below with its own strength and size.

Vintage & bootleg

Keyline and shadow wrap the whole design in one ink, like a 90s bootleg. Ghost is a faint, broken second print offset from the first, like a screen that slipped. For worn-out ink, try Washed out, Fabric weave, Squeegee streaks and Screen pinholes in Texture, or the Bootleg, Flea-market, Sun-faded and Thrashed looks.
